newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel capped at 129.86 near-term.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel capped at 129.86 near-term.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF will try to push higher on Friday, but will soon bump into resistance at 129.86, which will prove hard to crack as the market loses momentum, technical analysts said.
"Daily indicators are flattening, confirming the loss of upward momentum," said analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in a morning note.
"The objective at 129.86 retracement is looking increasingly remote, and should act as resistance even if prices draw near."
By 0854 GMT, the June notionnel on the MATIF was up 0.22 at 129.74, off an early high of 129.82.
Deutsche analysts said if this 129.86 level was reached, any further extension to 130.52 was unlikely, given the loss of momentum and the already high values of daily indicators.
They added a firm close on Friday was needed to increase the potential to 130.52.
They put key uptrend support at 128.66, which, if breached, would allow tests of 127.94. Below there, broad range support was near 127.60, they said.
"A break of 127.60 is likely to signal a resumption of the long-term delcines," they said.
Philippe Cahen, technical analyst at Credit Lyonnais in Paris, said on an hourly and daily basis, the market was not overbought.
He put resistance at 130.68, with initial support at 129.60. "But I think the market will continue to rise," he said.
He put second support at 129.54. "As long as we stay above there, I'm quite bullish," he said.
By 0931 GMT, the June Pibor contract was unchanged at 96.34.
